item.title: Right turn into old cheltenham road not available, 11th September
item.description:
The right turn green light onto old cheltenham road when travelling westbound on cheltenham road is only available about 70% of the light sequences, the rest of the time the lights turn red without allowing a right turn at all. This is causing tailbacks on cheltenham road as traffic is unable to turn right, thus blocking the entire road. Sitting in traffic that is blocked all the way back to greyhound gardens only to watch the lights turn red again without allowing any cars to move is frustrating to say the least. Please change it so that the right turn filter is enabled every full sequence change.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Gloucestershire Cycle Spine, Elmbridge, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Collapsed storm drain, 11th September
item.description:
I have been reporting this issue for years now and nothing is done- the problem only gets worse. There’s a constant flood on the road which prohibits us from accessing our drive without getting soaked, kids slip over on the slimy silt, it freezes in winter making the road a death trap. All the potholes are full of water and last time you attended site, you admitted the road needs digging up and the storm drain needs replacing under the road. When will this happen? Never? Are you waiting for the whole road to collapse due to a sink hole? Are you waiting for my house to collapse? I’m beyond frustrated with this issue and refuse to let it go untreated. I have requested your complaints procedure previously and had no response- please provide this ASAP as this issue is not being dealt with appropriately.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 60, School Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
